exposure: Maternal diabetes status and fetal sex
cohort: Singleton pregnancies in Sweden from 1998-2007, including those with maternal Type 1 diabetes (n = 4092), Type 2 diabetes (n = 412), gestational diabetes (n = 8602), and a reference group without diabetes (n = 905,565)
finding: The risk of adverse perinatal outcomes in offspring of mothers with Type 1 diabetes and gestational diabetes did not differ by sex, except for a higher risk in male infants for respiratory disorders.
mod_finding: Maternal Type 1 diabetes was associated with a higher rate of Cesarean delivery in male offspring.
